purpose: Replace the unsupervised PCA-96 + nearest-prototype space with a supervised metric-learning embedding (ArcFace / batch-hard triplet) trained on the Train fit block, and measure whether the Test S1-vs-S2 diagnostic AUC rises well above 0.7566 so that the clean three-way objective (LOSO rejection + Test S1 rejection + Test S2 acceptance)/3 can approach 0.85.

input_space_controls.label: PCA128_whitened_control
input_space_controls.purpose: Same prototype/threshold protocol in the exact space the network consumes (whitened PCA), without any learning.

input_space_controls.label: PCA128_raw_control
input_space_controls.purpose: Unwhitened PCA-128: the baseline-style space, to check that the scoring protocol itself reproduces the ~0.75 baseline separability.

selection_policy: Primary configuration is pre-registered (suggested protocol: PCA 128, 128-d embedding, ArcFace, mild augmentation). The other variants are reported for transparency. No variant, working point or hyper-parameter is selected with Test metrics or LOSO metrics.
